resources.string: Use nods and shakes while wearing your earbuds. Hold your head still at first.
Nod to answer and shake to decline. Phone state and answer-call permissions are required.
Double-nod or double-shake within 3s to control music while no call is active (a soft beep confirms the 1st gesture).

When off, the \"Ready for automatic connection\" notification moves to a silent, collapsed channel without a status bar icon. Android requires a notification for background monitoring, so it cannot be removed entirely.
To avoid false pauses, PodTide only pauses after the earbuds report sleep repeatedly over several minutes while both pods are worn.
